question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The removal of __petty.__ restrictions has made life easier.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"petty"** means something that is of little importance or trivial. (तुच्छ)

 
 
• **Example:** She was annoyed by the **petty** complaints of her colleagues.
 
 
 
• **"Small" **refers to something that is of a size that is less than normal or usual. It can also mean insignificant or unimportant. (छोटा)
 
 
• **Example:** They live in a** small **house at the end of the street.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Big** (बड़ा): Of considerable size, extent, or intensity.

 
 
• **Example:** They moved into a** big** house with a large garden.
 
 
 
• **Large** (विशाल): Of considerable or relatively great size, extent, or capacity.
 
 
• **Example:** The company is planning to build a **large** factory in the city.
 
 
 
• **Consequential** (परिणामी): Following as a result or effect; significant or important.
 
 
• **Example:** The decision to close the factory was** consequential **for the local economy.
